claims.claim: Added an incident-#168-shaped regression targeting production missing-Executor rejection before RUN creation, with Executor and verification calls forbidden, explicitly distinguishing the ingress caller from TASK-365 Human AUTO.

Coding-required ingress emits HUMAN_WAKEUP_REQUIRED with EXECUTOR_REQUIRED, exact failed_run_id, repair_sha and repair_dispatch_id, bounded Human instructions and false RUN/Executor flags. The existing original-Issue writer leaves this action open without scheduling dispatch.

Executorless routing requires fresh Runtime preflight, matching Unified State and correction identities, strict executor_required=false, eligible action and an unchanged final preflight. The workflow gates on this route; unavailable, malformed, contradictory or moved observations require Human action.

Human manual/AUTO carriers, profile resolution and immutable dispatch journal implementations remain unchanged. Added continuity regressions preserve exact selected or authenticated source profiles, manual priority, replay and collision protection, and reject bot-minted coding selection.

Focused regressions call production ingress, preflight, Unified State, wakeup/journal and checked-in workflow conditions for positive routing, Human continuity, missing currentness, conflicting identities, stale/moved proof, forged bot selection and repeated delivery. Structural fixtures contain no verification PASS.

Changes are confined to the seven permitted ingress, receipt, test and documentation files. Existing permissions, credentials, provenance and Runtime/Reviewer/Publisher boundaries are preserved, with no new persistent state, writer, lifecycle router or Gap 2 discovery.
